method_note: Judged by whether the image can prove the exact joke without crowded staging or tiny unreadable details.

candidates.title: The Chairs Disagreed
candidates.suggested_slide_arc: Slide 1: two chairs politely far apart. Slide 2: chairs angle inward while they pretend normal. Slide 3: knees/bag/dupatta cross the invisible border. Slide 4: both still say 'casual' while the room has already confessed.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: A small cafe table with Aachu and Zuv sitting too correctly, too politely, with awkward space between them.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: The two chairs are almost touching; both look away with guilty half-smiles.
candidates.visual_potential: Excellent: the furniture movement is the proof, not the caption.
failure_risks: Must avoid generic date cafe staging.
Chair positions need to stay readable across slides.

candidates.title: The Blanket Border Dispute
candidates.suggested_slide_arc: Slide 1: bed divided by a pillow border. Slide 2: one foot invades. Slide 3: blanket tug-of-war. Slide 4: morning, both tangled in the same blanket, still blaming each other.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Aachu and Zuv lying stiffly with a dramatic pillow line between them like a border.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: They wake up fully tangled, hair messy, one still clutching blanket like evidence.
candidates.visual_potential: Very clear and funny, but common unless text and expressions are specific.
failure_risks: Bed poses can create anatomy risk.
Could become too cartoonish or broad.
Needs premium restraint to avoid meme-panel energy.

candidates.title: Compliment Failed Successfully
candidates.suggested_slide_arc: Slide 1: Zuv rehearses a compliment. Slide 2: Aachu enters. Slide 3: he says the wrong normal thing. Slide 4: she understands anyway and smiles first.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Zuv in a kitchen/hallway holding a spoon like a microphone, rehearsing silently in a reflective cabinet or phone screen.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: Aachu catches the panic and smiles while he looks betrayed by his own mouth.
candidates.visual_potential: Strong face-expression idea, but text must not over-explain.
failure_risks: Needs one simple failed line, not a paragraph.

visual_risks: New-love ideas can become generic if the object proof is weak.
Married-fight ideas can become too meme-like if expressions are exaggerated.
